subject: general
question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is option 1) i.e. 'different'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The context of the concerned line is the definition of the figure of speech 'irony' as it expresses the meaning of something not in the actual literal sense but in the opposite sense.
 
• According to the above-mentioned points, the most appropriate word is 'different'. 
 
• 'Different' means 'not similar or same.'
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 1.

​

Correct Sentence:__* ...meaning is completely __different__ from the literal meaning. *

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
